Who we are

A movement, not a moment

We are a Christian, faith-led movement committed to raising people who know their identity in God, take responsibility for developing their gifts, pursue purpose with faith and excellence, and use their success and influence to create opportunities for others. We complement the work of the local church — we are not a replacement for it.

About us

Why we gather

Every testimony here is memory, and memory builds faith for what's next. Marvellously Helped by God exists to give those stories a home — a space for connection, encouragement, updates, testimonies, laughter and shared moments as we celebrate God's faithfulness together.

We believe God's help is not an end in itself. We are helped to become strong, and we become strong so that we can strengthen others.

Core values

Six values we live by

Faith

We believe in God, His Word and His ability to marvellously help us.

Integrity

We do what is right and remain aligned with our values, even when it is difficult.

Excellence

We develop our gifts, build capacity and give our best to what God has entrusted to us.

Love

We lead with compassion, generosity and a genuine desire to see others thrive.

Identity

We live from an understanding of who we are and whose we are.

Impact

We use our gifts, opportunities and influence to make a meaningful difference beyond ourselves.

Lead facilitator

Modupe Bakare

Lead Facilitator, Marvellously Helped by God (MHBG)

"I am a girl who has been marvellously helped by God, and I believe that what God has done in my life, He desires to multiply in the lives of others."

Modupe Bakare is a purpose-driven leader and mentor passionate about helping people discover their God-given identity, fulfil their purpose, and make a lasting impact.

With over 22 years of professional experience across the technology and consumer goods industries, she has built an international career spanning Nigeria, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom, holding leadership roles at global organisations including Heineken and Google.

Modupe holds a BSc in Chemistry from the University of Ibadan and an Executive MBA from Imperial College Business School, London. She is also a Fellow of the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (FCCA).

Beyond her professional accomplishments lies a powerful testimony of God's faithfulness. At ten, she survived a serious car accident that left her immobile for almost a year. She subsequently overcame significant academic setbacks, survived a gunshot injury early in her career, and navigated the painful journey of losing a loved one.

Through these experiences, she has learnt that God's help does not guarantee a life without challenges, but His grace can restore, redirect, sustain, and enable us to thrive despite them.

This conviction gave birth to Marvellously Helped by God (MHBG), a faith-led initiative dedicated to raising leaders who make global impact. As Lead Facilitator, Modupe seeks to inspire and equip young adults through testimonies, mentorship, purposeful gatherings, and practical empowerment.

At the heart of her work is a simple desire: to show the love and share the hope she has enjoyed through God's faithfulness, so that others may experience His help and flourish in their own journeys.

We are Marvellously Helped by God, and we are getting stronger. — 2 Chronicles 26:15b

Back to Eden

Life as God intended. Join us as we unlearn what limits us, embrace our God-given identity, and return to the original blueprint for how we were meant to live.

  • Date 27 February 2027
  • Time [ Add start time here ]
  • Venue Ibadan Business School, 70 Francis Okediji Street, Off Awolowo, Old Bodija, Ibadan, Nigeria

Why this theme

Back to Eden — Life as God Intended

At the heart of Marvellously Helped by God is a desire to raise people who know who they are, walk the earth in dominion, and make meaningful impact. But to live this way, we must first understand God's original design for our lives.

Too many of us have accepted limiting beliefs, ideologies and definitions of what is possible, without questioning whether they align with what God intended from the beginning.

Back to Eden is an invitation to rediscover that original design — to unlearn what limits us, embrace our God-given identity, and begin to see the extraordinary possibilities available to those who understand who they are in God.

Because we cannot fully live the life God intended while holding on to beliefs that contradict His intentions. It is time to return to the original blueprint and live as God intended.
